name: phone_disconnect
description: End this agent's phone-control activity. Immediately remove its overlay, UI declaration and pending notices. Does not stop the phone service, revoke credentials or disconnect other agents. Call as your final phone tool when finished; a new initialize or real tool call reconnects. Discovery and ping do not reconnect.
